statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and I48.91
The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The denial reason code is PR-204
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is clinically necessary to guide treatment of the arrhythmia
